ideas.pitch: Real-time student engagement and event coordination platform for Indian academic institutions.
ideas.title: CampusPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the SpaceFlow pattern by focusing on workspace and event planning utility that judges can immediately test live during the hackathon.

ideas.pitch: Multi-language patient triage and preliminary health logging web app tailored for local community clinics.
ideas.title: MediTriage Local
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the multi-language healthcare triage approach proven successful in mediscan-ai, addressing local accessibility.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered nutrition tracking and meal recommendation engine optimized for traditional Indian cuisine.
ideas.title: NutriDesi
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the winning formula of E-Foodiee by targeting everyday health and nutrition with localized dietary data.

ideas.pitch: Digital branch experience platform providing simulated loan application workflows with instant document verification.
ideas.title: LoanCue
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the successful FinTech workflow demonstrated by CapitalCue, focusing on clean user journeys for judges.

ideas.pitch: Language acquisition platform that helps users learn regional Indian languages through crowdsourced short-form video context.
ideas.title: LinguaShorts
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the Mora pattern of authentic, media-driven language learning that appeals strongly to student demographic judges.
